 Advertisement Coco Gauff ready to represent team USA in hometown of Delray Beach
 Advertisement Updated: 5:59 PM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Yianni Kourakis Sports Anchor/Reporter Coco Gauff ready to represent team USA in hometown of Delray Beach
 Updated: 5:59 PM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Yianni Kourakis Sports Anchor/Reporter DELRAY BEACH, Fla. — Delray Beach's Coco Gauff won't have any trouble finding the Delray Beach Tennis Center this week when she represents Team USA in the Billie Jean King Cup. The two-time grand slam champion grew up playing sports at the facility. 
 Gauff and Team USA will take on Hungary for the best-of-five team event.
 Advertisement "I'm super excited to represent my country in my hometown, be with the girls this weekend, compete and have fun," said the 22-year-old.
 Yianni Kourakis goes one-on-one with tennis star Coco Gauff "To have Coco commit to playing is huge for the event but also for our team and we are looking for her to be a leader at such a young age," said team captain Lindsay Davenport.
 For someone who was a flag bearer for team USA at the 2024 Olympics, American pride is nothing new for the 22-year-old, but playing for team USA in front of family and friends is a unique experience.
 "Growing up in this town, they poured so much into me, so much love into me so whenever I can show up and reciprocate that, it's always a pleasure," Gauff said.
 Gauff will make an appearance at nearby Atlantic High School on Thursday ahead of the tournament that begins on Saturday.
